narrative:
Clinton County has 27,277 registered voters, with 53.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 7.9%, a pronounced Republican lean of 30.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.3% of registrants.
